title: The specified finite compact-support scalar comparison data
statement: Let $A,B$ be finite commutative rings, $\phi:A\to B$ a ring map, and $j:X\to Z$ an open immersion of schemes. Write $J_A$ for the exact derived etale extension by zero and $S_T$ for derived extension of coefficients on the etale site. Define $\operatorname{openScalarIso}:J_A S_Z\simeq S_X J_B$ by uniqueness of the left adjoints of the common open/coefficient restriction composite, using the specified open restriction isomorphism. For a compactification $c=(j,g)$ with noetherian $Z,Y$, define compactScalarIso as the proper scalar mate of [lem-asd-proper-finite-coefficient-extension] followed by proper image of openScalarIso. For each scheme $T$, define scalarRingMap to be the actual map of constant ring sheaves induced by $\phi$. Define intrinsicSiteFunctorIso as the derived composition comparison from fixed-scalar site inverse image followed by the intrinsic realization equivalence. Define realizationScalarIso by left-adjoint uniqueness from the sectionwise inverse-realization/restriction square of [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars], and siteScalarIso by composing it with the canonical site/scalar comparison of [lem-pur-etale-scalar-mate-projection]. Define compactRealizationIso using the realization equivalence unit for open extension and the normalized proper realization comparison. Define compactSiteIso on bounded-below etale inputs by the canonical compact-support site comparison [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison] followed by this realization comparison. Finally, for bounded-below etale $G,GB$ and an actual scalar-extension identification $S_XG\simeq GB$, define intrinsicCompactScalarIsoOfOrigin by transporting compactScalarIso through compactSiteIso and siteScalarIso, inserting that identification and its inverse. These are the nine existing explicit constructions relocated verbatim from the item module, with all their original Lean universes and hypotheses preserved. No compatibility equality is asserted by this definition record.

def openScalarIso
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        scalarExtension φ Z ≅
      scalarExtension φ X ⋙
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j).mapDerivedCategory
